senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v.) [to be heated, passionate,] to insult, do violence, to rob.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:10">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>לא סוף … אלא חֲמוֹס וכ׳</he> finally one does not say to another man, Kill that man, but, Attack &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> (ref. to <he>חמסי</he>, <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:5">ib. XVI, 5</cite>) <he>חוֹמְסֵנִי את בדברים וכ׳</he> thou provokest me to speak harshly, because thou seest &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>, beg. <he>מלכות … גוזלת וחוֹמֶסֶת</he> the wicked government (Rome) robs and extorts; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>דור ודור וחוֹמְסָיו</he> each generation with its violent men.—Part. pass. <he>חָמוּס</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26">Ib.</cite> s. 30 <he>גזול אני ח׳ אני</he> I have been taken by force, by extortion.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 6</cite> <he>כגנה שנ׳ מעיינה וכ׳</he> like a garden the spring of which has been ruined, so that its vegetables fade.

senses.gloss: (of beasts of prey) to seize with fangs, scratch with nails.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> (play on <he>חמסי</he>, v. supra) <he>חִימְּסָה פניו</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בפניו</he>, some ed. <cite ref="H00808"><he>חימסא</he></cite>, incorr.) she scratched his face; Y’lamd. to Gen. l. c. (quot. in Ar.) <he>חיטטה אותו וחימסה פניו כנמיה</he> she scratched him and marked his face like a marten; Yalk. ib. 79 (not <he>חומסה</he>).
